_rationale: Stddev=0 makes the lognormal formula deterministic: exp(mu + 0*z) = exp(log(1.05)) = 1.05. Every year except 2028 is +5% blended. Black swan REPLACES the drawn factors in 2028 (not scales them), so the prescribed historical return is applied consistently regardless of what the base draw happened to be: stock factor = 0.5, bond factor = 0.9, blended = 0.6*0.5 + 0.4*0.9 = 0.66. path[0]=500000 (start of 2026), path[1]=500000*1.05=525000, path[2]=525000*1.05=551250, path[3]=551250*0.66=363825, path[4]=363825*1.05=382016.25. probability=100 (no spending).

pathValues.note: After 2028 black swan: 551250 * 0.66 (factors replaced, not scaled)
